senses.zh_definition: Santino：意大利语来源的人名，可作男性名字，也见作姓氏；具体所指须依上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: An Italian personal name used as a masculine given name and also as a surname; its referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama orang yang berasal daripada bahasa Itali, digunakan sebagai nama lelaki dan juga nama keluarga; orang yang dimaksudkan bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专名，正常书写为 Santino。资料包没有提供足以确定具体人物的上下文，也没有正式马来语普通词释义。这里的马来语释义为说明性释义；搭配为教学示例，不代表高频统计结果。[Santino 姓氏及其人名来源](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Santino?geo-lang=en)

etymology.historical_story: Santino belongs to Italian naming traditions. The Dictionary of American Family Names explains the surname through the personal name Santino, a pet form of Santo. When such a name appears in Malay conversation, it continues to identify a person rather than acquire a general dictionary meaning. The packet does not identify a particular bearer.
